description: C# port of ts-fsrs 6.0.0: the Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler (FSRS-3, 4, 4.5, 5, 6, 7) with a composable scheduler/middleware kit and the legacy v5 API.

Idiomatic, zero-overhead .NET bindings for Intel Open Image Denoise 2.5.1 (AI ray-tracing denoising). Provides a Vortice-style managed API (IDisposable, Span<T>) alongside full ClangSharp-generated P/Invoke bindings and bundled native runtimes for win-x64, linux-x64, osx-arm64 (Metal), and osx-x64.
Peráta's SDK for .NET: products, customers, checkouts, payments, subscriptions and webhooks.
